source_quote.quote: GBMs of the study patients must have EGFR gene amplification, which will be detected by next generation sequencing of tumor tissue from resected sample.

flag.reason: EGFR amplification is an entry requirement for a JAK-inhibitor trial (prior EGFR or JAK inhibitor excluded), but the record states no mechanistic link between EGFR and tofacitinib; a reviewer could judge it matched via EGFR-JAK/STAT signalling.

coder_notes: Tofacitinib (JAK inhibitor) is the only investigational agent, given with temozolomide (arm 1) or lomustine (arm 2) as background chemotherapy; TMZ and lomustine coded soc_backbone in their respective arms. Arm 1 label says 'Newly diagnosed or Recurrent off Temozolomide' but inclusion criteria require recurrence after chemoradiotherapy, so treatment_setting coded recurrent. Registered phase is PHASE3 although single-group design. Outcome text mentions tofacitinib 5 mg vs 10 mg in arms (inconsistency). EGFR amplification eligibility flagged uncertain for candidate matching (see biomarker flag).
